verdict.rationale: Synthesia's documented features are close to this story but don't deliver it. It can build an avatar of yourself from one photo, offers preset avatar styles (3D, comic, anime, claymation), and can turn a file into a video. None of these is documented as generating new footage that matches the visual style of a reference video or image. These are adjacent capabilities, such as avatar identity from a photo and fixed style presets, not reference-driven style generation.

support.subject: As a creator, I can point at a reference video or image and generate new footage in that style
